families.title: Phase-dependent turning

families.title: Many surviving components

families.title: Singular boundary limit

physical_validity: both finite-radius bores are machined continuously from exterior faces and traverse the stock; no cavity is created by teleportation
at center separation 8 the two removed cylindrical passages meet at the exact singular tangency limit without positive-area overlap

the equality case is recorded as TANGENT, not coerced to either neighbour by epsilon or sampling

families.title: Scale and precision separation

setups.purpose: same local precision witness under an exact rigid rotation

physical_validity: both pocket faces are top-accessible and leave an exact positive web of 1/1000000 mm near x=999 inside a 1000 mm stock extent
the same local gap is independently represented before and after an exact translation of +998 mm; translation cannot consume precision
an exact +90 degree setup rotation preserves the local gap and durable body B-F12 rather than rebuilding or quantizing stock
